newsitem.title: USA: Georgia gains 15,000 service jobs in February.
newsitem.headline: Georgia gains 15,000 service jobs in February.

text.p: Georgia gained back 15,000 service jobs in February after losing 80,000 in January, state Labor Commissioner David Poythress said Friday.

Wage and salary employment rose to 3.54 million in February. Most of the added services jobs were at temporary employment agencies, tax preparation offices and amusements. Construction and manufacturing added another 1,600 jobs over the month.
Poythress said the January drop and the February rebound followed the normal pattern that begins with post-holiday layoffs in the retail industry.
"By February, the job market has begun returning to its normal pattern and right now that means a steady increase in employment," Poythress said.
Three-quarters of the new jobs were in the Atlanta metropolitan area, where employment rose to 1.92 million in February from 1.9 million in January.
